source: OWASP WSTG v4 — Authentication, Authorization, Session Management, Input Validation, Client-Side, Server-Side
description: QRadar SIEM alert rules mapped from WSTG-ATHN (04), WSTG-ATHZ (05), WSTG-SESS (06), WSTG-INPV (07), WSTG-CLNT (08), WSTG-SERV (09) test catalogs

rules.name: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects SQL injection payloads in authentication endpoints attempting to bypass login via tautology, OR 1=1, or UNION-based attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth%') AND (payload ILIKE '%OR 1=1%' OR payload ILIKE %' OR '1'='1%' OR payload ILIKE '%' UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%admin'--%' OR payload ILIKE '%' OR 1=1--%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Brute Force Authentication Attempt
rules.description: Detects multiple failed authentication attempts from a single source indicating brute force attack
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as failed_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/authenticate%') AND payload ILIKE '%failed%' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING failed_count > 10

rules.name: Credential Stuffing Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing attacks characterized by rapid authentication attempts with different usernames from a single source
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(DISTINCT username) as unique_users FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth/token%') AND payload ILIKE '%failed%' GROUP BY sourceip LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING unique_users > 20

rules.name: Authentication Over Unencrypted Channel
rules.description: Detects authentication requests over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials in transit
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE 'http://%/login%' OR URL ILIKE 'http://%/auth%' OR URL ILIKE 'http://%/api/v%/token%') AND NOT destinationport = 443 LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Default Credential Usage Attempt
rules.description: Detects authentication attempts using default credentials (admin/admin, root/root, test/test) on production systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, username FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth%') AND (username ILIKE '%admin%' AND payload ILIKE '%admin%') OR (username ILIKE '%root%' AND payload ILIKE '%root%') OR (username ILIKE '%test%') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: MFA Bypass via Alternative Channel
rules.description: Detects authentication success without corresponding MFA verification indicating MFA bypass
rules.aql_query: SELECT username, sourceip FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/auth/token%' AND payload ILIKE '%success%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.username = events.username AND e2.URL ILIKE '%/mfa/verify%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: PostgreSQL pg_authid Credential Hash Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to PostgreSQL authentication catalog revealing password hashes
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM pg_authid%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_authid%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_shadow%' OR payload ILIKE '%rolpassword%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_dbadmin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: MySQL User Table Credential Hash Access
rules.description: Detects queries accessing MySQL user table containing password hashes
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%mysql.user%' OR payload ILIKE '%SELECT * FROM mysql.user%' OR payload ILIKE '%authentication_string%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_dbadmin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Redis ACL User Password Exposure
rules.description: Detects Redis CONFIG GET or ACL LIST commands that expose user passwords
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%CONFIG GET requirepass%' OR payload ILIKE '%ACL LIST%' OR payload ILIKE '%ACL GETUSER%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_redis_admin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: MongoDB admin Database Credential Access
rules.description: Detects access to MongoDB admin database system.users collection containing credentials
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%admin.system.users%' OR payload ILIKE '%db.getUsers%' OR payload ILIKE '%db.system.users.find%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_mongodb_admin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: JWT Algorithm None Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens using 'none' algorithm allowing authentication bypass without signature verification
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE '%eyJhbGciOiJub25l%') OR (header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE '%"alg":"none"%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Authentication Token in URL Query Parameter
rules.description: Detects authentication tokens passed in URL query parameters vulnerable to logging and referrer leakage
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%?token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?access_token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?session_id=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?auth_token=%') AND NOT URL ILIKE '%/auth/callback%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Kubernetes Secret Access from Unauthorized Pod
rules.description: Detects access to Kubernetes secrets from unauthorized pods or service accounts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/namespaces/%/secrets/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/secrets%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_pod') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Password Reset Token Predictable or Long-Lived
rules.description: Detects password reset tokens that appear sequential, predictable, or have excessive validity periods
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/reset-password/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/forgot-password/%') GROUP BY sourceip, URL, devicetime LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

rules.name: IDOR - Sequential ID Access Pattern
rules.description: Detects sequential IDOR patterns where a user accesses resources with incrementing IDs indicating automated enumeration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/1%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orders/1%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT URL) > 10

rules.name: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects queries attempting to bypass PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%SET row_security%OFF%' OR payload ILIKE '%DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY%' OR payload ILIKE '%BYPASSRLS%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_dbadmin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection in Authorization Query
rules.description: Detects SQL injection payloads in authorization/access control queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/access%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/permissions%') AND (payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE %' OR 1=1%' OR payload ILIKE %'; DROP TABLE%' OR payload ILIKE '%-- -%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: NoSQL Injection in MongoDB Authorization Query
rules.description: Detects MongoDB NoSQL injection operators ($ne, $gt, $regex) in authorization requests
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/auth%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/access%') AND (payload ILIKE '%$ne%' OR payload ILIKE '%$gt%' OR payload ILIKE '%$regex%' OR payload ILIKE '%$where%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Privilege Escalation - Admin API Access by Regular User
rules.description: Detects regular user accounts accessing admin-only API endpoints
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/manage%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/superuser%') AND NOT username IN (SELECT username FROM REFERENCE_SET WHERE type = 'admin_users') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mass Assignment - Role Elevation Attempt
rules.description: Detects mass assignment attacks attempting to set role, isAdmin, or permission fields via API requests
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%role=admin%' OR payload ILIKE '%isAdmin=true%' OR payload ILIKE '%permissions=[%' OR payload ILIKE '%user_type=admin%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: GraphQL Authorization Bypass via Alias Exploitation
rules.description: Detects GraphQL queries using aliases to access unauthorized data fields or types
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND (payload ILIKE '%alias%' OR payload ILIKE '%__schema%' OR LENGTH(payload) > 3000) GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

rules.name: Neo4j Cypher Injection Authorization Bypass
rules.description: Detects Cypher injection attempts in graph database queries bypassing authorization
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%MATCH (%' AND payload ILIKE '%WHERE%') AND (payload ILIKE '%OR 1=1%' OR payload ILIKE '%OR true%' OR payload ILIKE '%SKIP %LIMIT %') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_graph_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Cross-Tenant Data Access via Shared Database Connection
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data access patterns in multi-tenant database environments
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%tenant_id=%' OR payload ILIKE '%org_id=%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_tenant_service' AND NOT payload ILIKE '%current_tenant%' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payload) > 3

rules.name: Firestore Security Rules Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to access Firestore data bypassing client-side security rules via Admin SDK
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%firestore.googleapis.com/v1/%' OR URL ILIKE '%.cloudfunctions.net/firestore%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_firestore_client') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Session Fixation Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects session fixation attacks where session IDs are set before authentication
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Set-Cookie' AND header_value ILIKE '%session%' AND URL ILIKE '%/login%' AND NOT header_value ILIKE '%Secure%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Session Token in Referer Header Leakage
rules.description: Detects session tokens or authentication data leaked via Referer headers to external domains
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Referer' AND (header_value ILIKE '%session_id=%' OR header_value ILIKE '%token=%' OR header_value ILIKE '%PHPSESSID=%' OR header_value ILIKE '%JSESSIONID=%') AND NOT destinationip ILIKE '%internal-domain.com%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Concurrent Session from Multiple IPs
rules.description: Detects concurrent sessions from different IP addresses using the same session token indicating session hijacking
rules.aql_query: SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT sourceip) as ip_count FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE 'Bearer %' GROUP BY username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING ip_count > 3

rules.name: Redis Session Store Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to Redis session stores containing session data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE destinationport = 6379 AND (payload ILIKE '%KEYS *%' OR payload ILIKE '%GET session:%' OR payload ILIKE '%HGETALL session%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_app_server' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Session Token PII in JWT Claims
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens containing PII (email, phone, address) in claims that should not be exposed
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE 'Bearer eyJ%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%email%' OR header_value ILIKE '%phone%' OR header_value ILIKE '%address%' OR header_value ILIKE '%ssn%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: CSRF Token Missing on State-Changing Requests
rules.description: Detects POST/PUT/DELETE requests without CSRF tokens enabling cross-site request forgery attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%POST %' OR payload ILIKE '%PUT %' OR payload ILIKE '%DELETE %') AND NOT payload ILIKE '%csrf%' AND NOT payload ILIKE '%_token%' AND (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orders%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/payments%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Session Cookie Without Secure and HttpOnly Flags
rules.description: Detects session cookies missing both Secure and HttpOnly flags making them vulnerable to theft
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Set-Cookie' AND (header_value ILIKE '%session%' OR header_value ILIKE '%token%') AND NOT header_value ILIKE '%Secure%' AND NOT header_value ILIKE '%HttpOnly%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Session Token in Database Query Log
rules.description: Detects session tokens appearing in database query logs indicating sensitive data exposure in logging infrastructure
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%session_token%' OR payload ILIKE '%auth_token%' OR payload ILIKE '%refresh_token%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_audit_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: SQL Injection - Classic Tautology Bypass
rules.description: Detects classic SQL injection tautology attacks (OR 1=1, ' OR '1'='1) in web requests
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%OR 1=1%' OR payload ILIKE "%' OR '1'='1'%" OR payload ILIKE '%OR TRUE--%' OR payload ILIKE "%1 OR 1=1%") AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection - UNION-Based Data Extraction
rules.description: Detects UNION-based SQL injection attacks attempting to extract data from database tables
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%UNION ALL SELECT%' OR payload ILIKE '%ORDER BY 1--%' OR payload ILIKE "%' UNION SELECT NULL--%") AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection - Blind Time-Based Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects time-based blind SQL injection using SLEEP, WAITFOR, or BENCHMARK functions
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%SLEEP(%' OR payload ILIKE '%WAITFOR DELAY%' OR payload ILIKE '%BENCHMARK(%' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_sleep(%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Injection - Error-Based Data Disclosure
rules.description: Detects error-based SQL injection attacks using database error messages to extract data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%CONVERT(int,%' OR payload ILIKE '%CAST(%' OR payload ILIKE '%EXTRACTVALUE(%' OR payload ILIKE '%UPDATEXML(%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: NoSQL Injection - MongoDB Operator Injection
rules.description: Detects MongoDB NoSQL injection using $ne, $gt, $regex, $where operators
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%{"$ne":"%' OR payload ILIKE '%{"$gt":"%' OR payload ILIKE '%{"$regex":"%' OR payload ILIKE '%$where:%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: XSS - Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
rules.description: Detects reflected XSS attacks using script injection in URL parameters and form inputs
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%

rules.name: Command Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects OS command injection attempts using shell metacharacters (;, |, `, $())
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%; ls%' OR payload ILIKE '%| cat /etc/passwd%' OR payload ILIKE '%`id`%' OR payload ILIKE '%$(whoami)%' OR payload ILIKE '%& ping%' OR payload ILIKE '%/bin/sh%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
rules.description: Detects SSRF attempts targeting internal services, cloud metadata endpoints, and localhost addresses
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%http://127.0.0.1%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://localhost%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://169.254.169.254%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://[::1]%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://0.0.0.0%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://10.0.0.%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://192.168.%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
rules.description: Detects SSTI attacks using template expression syntax ({{, ${, <%  in various template engines
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%{{7*7}}%' OR payload ILIKE '%${7*7}%' OR payload ILIKE '%<%= 7*7 %>%' OR payload ILIKE '%#{7*7}%' OR payload ILIKE '%{{config}}%' OR payload ILIKE '%{{__class__}}%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
rules.description: Detects XXE injection attempts using DOCTYPE ENTITY declarations to read files or SSRF
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%<!DOCTYPE%' AND payload ILIKE '%ENTITY%') OR (payload ILIKE '%<!ENTITY%' AND payload ILIKE '%SYSTEM%') OR (payload ILIKE '%<!ENTITY%' AND payload ILIKE '%PUBLIC%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Insecure Deserialization Attack
rules.description: Detects insecure deserialization attacks using Java, PHP, Python, or .NET serialized objects
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%rO0AB%' OR payload ILIKE '%O:22%' OR payload ILIKE '%__reduce__%' OR payload ILIKE '%System.Runtime.Serialization%' OR payload ILIKE '%JavaSerializer%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: HTTP Request Smuggling
rules.description: Detects HTTP request smuggling attempts using Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding discrepancies
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%Content-Length:%' AND payload ILIKE '%Transfer-Encoding: chunked%') OR (payload ILIKE '%Transfer-Encoding:%' AND payload ILIKE '%chunked%' AND payload ILIKE '%Content-Length: 0%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: LDAP Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects LDAP injection attacks using LDAP search filter metacharacters
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%)(|(cn=%' OR payload ILIKE '%*)(|(%' OR payload ILIKE '%)(objectClass=%' OR payload ILIKE '%*)((%') AND (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/search%' OR URL ILIKE '%/ldap%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Neo4j Cypher Injection - Data Extraction
rules.description: Detects Cypher injection attacks on Neo4j graph databases extracting node and relationship data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%MATCH (n)%' AND payload ILIKE '%WHERE n.name%') AND (payload ILIKE "%' OR 1=1%" OR payload ILIKE '%OR TRUE%' OR payload ILIKE '%RETURN n%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_graph_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Cassandra CQL Injection
rules.description: Detects CQL injection attempts on Cassandra databases bypassing query parameterization
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%ALLOW FILTERING%' AND (payload ILIKE "%' OR '%'=%" OR payload ILIKE '%; SELECT%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_cassandra_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: PostgreSQL COPY TO/FROM File Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL COPY commands used for file system data exfiltration via SQL injection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%COPY % TO %' OR payload ILIKE '%COPY % FROM %' OR payload ILIKE '%pg_read_file%' OR payload ILIKE '%lo_import%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_dbadmin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: MySQL LOAD_FILE File System Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects MySQL LOAD_FILE() function calls used to read server files via SQL injection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%LOAD_FILE(%' OR payload ILIKE '%INTO OUTFILE%' OR payload ILIKE '%INTO DUMPFILE%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_dbadmin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: SQL Server xp_cmdshell OS Command Execution
rules.description: Detects SQL Server xp_cmdshell stored procedure execution via SQL injection enabling OS command execution
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%xp_cmdshell%' OR payload ILIKE '%sp_configure%xp_cmdshell%' OR payload ILIKE '%OPENROWSET%' OR payload ILIKE '%BULK INSERT%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_dbadmin' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Host Header Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects Host header injection attacks for cache poisoning, password reset manipulation, or SSRF
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Host' AND (header_value NOT ILIKE '%.example.com%' AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%.internal.com%' AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%localhost%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'cdn_proxy') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: HTTP Parameter Pollution Attack
rules.description: Detects HTTP Parameter Pollution attacks sending duplicate parameters to bypass validation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%&%' AND URL ILIKE '%=duplicate%') OR (payload ILIKE '%param1=value1%param1=value2%') GROUP BY sourceip LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

rules.name: DOM XSS - Location Source to innerHTML Sink
rules.description: Detects DOM-based XSS patterns where location.href/URL values flow into innerHTML sinks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%document.location%' OR payload ILIKE '%window.location%') AND (payload ILIKE '%.innerHTML%' OR payload ILIKE '%.outerHTML%') AND (URL ILIKE '%?%=%<script%' OR URL ILIKE '%#<script%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Stored XSS Detection
rules.description: Detects stored XSS payloads persisted in the application and served to other users
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%

rules.name: PostMessage Cross-Origin Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects postMessage handlers that send sensitive data to wildcard origins (*)
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%postMessage(%' AND payload ILIKE '%"*"%') OR (payload ILIKE '%window.postMessage(%' AND payload ILIKE "%'*'%") LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: LocalStorage Sensitive Data Storage
rules.description: Detects sensitive data (tokens, PII) being stored in browser localStorage via JavaScript
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%localStorage.setItem%' OR payload ILIKE '%localStorage.set%') AND (payload ILIKE '%token%' OR payload ILIKE '%password%' OR payload ILIKE '%ssn%' OR payload ILIKE '%credit_card%') LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Service Worker Registration on Sensitive Pages
rules.description: Detects service worker registration on pages handling sensitive data that could intercept requests
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%navigator.serviceWorker.register%' AND (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%' OR URL ILIKE '%/banking%' OR URL ILIKE '%/checkout%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: SQL Injection in HTTP Headers
rules.description: Detects SQL injection payloads in HTTP headers (User-Agent, Referer, Cookie, X-Forwarded-For)
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_name, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_name IN ('User-Agent', 'Referer', 'Cookie', 'X-Forwarded-For', 'X-Real-IP')) AND (header_value ILIKE '%'' OR 1=1%' OR header_value ILIKE '%UNION SELECT%' OR header_value ILIKE '%SLEEP(%' OR header_value ILIKE '%WAITFOR DELAY%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Second-Order SQL Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects second-order SQL injection where stored payloads execute in later database queries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orders/%') AND (payload ILIKE "%' OR %' OR payload ILIKE '%'; --%' OR payload ILIKE "%'); %") AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: WAF Bypass via Encoding
rules.description: Detects WAF bypass attempts using URL encoding, double encoding, Unicode encoding, or HTML entity encoding
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%2527%' OR URL ILIKE '%252f%' OR URL ILIKE '%u0027%' OR URL ILIKE '%'%' OR URL ILIKE '%'%' OR URL ILIKE '%27%29%' OR URL ILIKE '%2500%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Race Condition - Double Withdrawal
rules.description: Detects concurrent requests to financial endpoints indicating race condition exploitation for double spending
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/withdraw%' OR URL ILIKE '%/transfer%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' GROUP BY sourceip, username, URL, devicetime LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

rules.name: JWT Weak Secret - Brute Force Attempt
rules.description: Detects rapid JWT validation failures indicating brute force attacks against weak JWT secrets
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as failed_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/auth/token%' OR URL ILIKE '%/jwt/validate%') AND payload ILIKE '%invalid signature%' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING failed_count > 10

rules.name: Padding Oracle Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects padding oracle attacks characterized by varying ciphertext with different HTTP response status codes
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, COUNT(DISTINCT payload) as variant_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/auth%' OR URL ILIKE '%/token%' OR URL ILIKE '%/decrypt%') GROUP BY sourceip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING variant_count > 50

rules.name: Business Logic - Negative Quantity or Price
rules.description: Detects API requests with negative quantities or prices indicating business logic manipulation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/cart%' OR URL ILIKE '%/order%' OR URL ILIKE '%/checkout%') AND (payload ILIKE '%quantity":-%' OR payload ILIKE '%price":-%' OR payload ILIKE '%amount":-%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: HTTP/2 Request Smuggling via H2.TE
rules.description: Detects HTTP/2 request smuggling using Transfer-Encoding discrepancies or extended CONNECT methods
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%HTTP/2%' AND payload ILIKE '%Transfer-Encoding%') OR (payload ILIKE '%:method CONNECT%' AND payload ILIKE '%:protocol%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: GraphQL Query Depth Attack
rules.description: Detects deeply nested GraphQL queries exceeding normal depth limits indicating DoS or data extraction
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND LENGTH(payload) > 5000 GROUP BY sourceip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

rules.name: Prototype Pollution Attack
rules.description: Detects prototype pollution attacks using __proto__, constructor.prototype, or Object.assign
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%__proto__%' OR payload ILIKE '%constructor[prototype]%' OR payload ILIKE '%prototype%' OR payload ILIKE '%Object.assign%') AND (payload ILIKE '%admin%' OR payload ILIKE '%isAdmin%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: ArangoDB AQL Injection - Multi-Model Data Extraction
rules.description: Detects AQL injection attacks on ArangoDB extracting data from collections
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%FOR doc IN%' AND payload ILIKE '%FILTER%') AND (payload ILIKE "%' OR 1=1%" OR payload ILIKE '%OR true%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_arangodb_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: DynamoDB FilterExpression Injection
rules.description: Detects DynamoDB FilterExpression or KeyConditionExpression injection bypassing access controls
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%dynamodb%' OR URL ILIKE '%.execute-api.%') AND (payload ILIKE '%FilterExpression%' AND (payload ILIKE '%:v1 OR %' OR payload ILIKE '%contains(%' OR payload ILIKE '%begins_with(%')) AND NOT sourceip = 'authorized_lambda' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: InfluxDB Flux Query Injection
rules.description: Detects Flux query injection on InfluxDB time-series databases extracting measurement data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%from(bucket:%' AND payload ILIKE '%|> filter%') AND (payload ILIKE '%|> limit%' OR payload ILIKE '%|> range(%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_influxdb_service' GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

rules.name: Pinecone Metadata Filter Injection
rules.description: Detects injection in Pinecone vector database metadata filters extracting unauthorized vector data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%pinecone.io/%' AND (payload ILIKE '%filter%' AND (payload ILIKE '%$ne%' OR payload ILIKE '%$gt%' OR payload ILIKE '%$regex%')) AND NOT sourceip = 'authorized_pinecone_client' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Container Escape - Docker Socket Access
rules.description: Detects access to Docker socket from application container enabling container escape and host access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/var/run/docker.sock%' OR URL ILIKE '%docker.sock%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_docker_host' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: OAuth Token Theft via Redirect URI Manipulation
rules.description: Detects OAuth redirect URI manipulation attempts stealing authorization codes or tokens
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/oauth/authorize%redirect_uri=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/oauth/callback%code=%') AND NOT URL ILIKE '%authorized_redirect_domain%' AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_oauth_server' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Sensitive Data in Cleartext Transmission
rules.description: Detects transmission of sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII) over unencrypted HTTP connections
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE 'http://%/login%' OR URL ILIKE 'http://%/api/v%/token%' OR URL ILIKE 'http://%/api/v%/password%') AND NOT destinationport = 443 LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: CSRF - State-Changing Request Without Token
rules.description: Detects POST/PUT/DELETE requests to state-changing endpoints without CSRF tokens from cross-origin referrers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value, URL FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Referer' AND NOT header_value ILIKE '%samedomain.com%' AND (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orders/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/payments/%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Arbitrary File Read via Path Traversal
rules.description: Detects path traversal attempts reading /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, Windows system files, or cloud metadata
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%../../../etc/passwd%' OR URL ILIKE '%../../../etc/shadow%' OR URL ILIKE '%..\..\..\windows\%' OR URL ILIKE '%..%2f..%2f..%2fetc%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: CORS Misconfiguration - Arbitrary Origin with Credentials
rules.description: Detects CORS configurations allowing arbitrary origins with credentials enabled
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%trusted-domain.com%' AND NOT header_value IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.header_name = 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' AND e2.header_value = 'true') LAST 1 HOURS
